description: An AI-powered assistant embedded directly inside ERPNext/Frappe as a custom Frappe app called frappe_ai_assistant. The core idea is to make ERPNext accessible to non-technical business users by giving them an AI guide that lives inside the ERP itself — not as a separate website or browser extension.
